excerpts:
## WeakAuras

A World of Warcraft addon that provides a powerful framework to
display customizable graphics on your screen.

[GitHub](https://github.com/WeakAuras/WeakAuras2 "GitHub Project")

[CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/weakauras-2 "Addon listing on CurseForge.com")

[Discord](https://discord.gg/weakauras "Discord Server")

[Support us on Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/bePatron?u=3216523&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fweakauras.wtf%2F&utm_medium=widget "Patreon Page")

* * *

## WeakAuras Companion

A desktop application that allows you to update your auras from Wago.io and can create regular backups of them.

[Windows](https://github.com/WeakAuras/WeakAuras-Companion/releases/latest)

[macOS](https://github.com/WeakAuras/WeakAuras-Companion/releases/latest)

[Linux](https://github.com/WeakAuras/WeakAuras-Companion/releases/latest)

* Fix overlays not updating if nothing else changed
* Workaround a issue in LibSpellRange
* Convert region types of clones too
* Special case FRAME\_UPDATE event also for custom triggers
* Fix nil error on empty nameinfo
* Reset xOffset and yOffset on adding to a dynamic group
* Fix Load conditions for encounter ids
* Fix a few bugs, remove TODOs
